title: Phosphorylation of GCN2 by mTOR confers adaptation to conditions of hyper-mTOR activation under stress.
authors: Darawshi, Odai; Yassin, Olaya; Shmuel, Miri; Wek, Ronald C; Mahdizadeh, S Jalil; Eriksson, Leif A; Hatzoglou, Maria; Tirosh, Boaz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究GCN2磷酸化与mTOR信号通路在氨基酸应激中的调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与课题无关。
abstract: Adaptation to the shortage in free amino acids (AA) is mediated by 2 pathways, the integrated stress response (ISR) and the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR). In response to reduced levels, primarily of leucine or arginine, mTOR in its complex 1 configuration (mTORC1) is suppressed leading to a decrease in translation initiation and elongation. The eIF2alpha kinase general control nonderepressible 2 (GCN2) is activated by uncharged tRNAs, leading to induction of the ISR in response to a broader range of AA shortage. ISR confers a reduced translation initiation, while promoting the selective synthesis of stress proteins, such as ATF4. To efficiently adapt to AA starvation, the 2 pathways are cross-regulated at multiple levels. Here we identified a new mechanism of ISR/mTORC1 crosstalk that optimizes survival under AA starvation, when mTORC1 is forced to remain active. mTORC1 activation during acute AA shortage, augmented ATF4 expression in a GCN2-dependent manner. Under these conditions, enhanced GCN2 activity was not dependent on tRNA sensing, inferring a different activation mechanism. We identified a labile physical interaction between GCN2 and mTOR that results in a phosphorylation of GCN2 on serine 230 by mTOR, which promotes GCN2 activity. When examined under prolonged AA starvation, GCN2 phosphorylation by mTOR promoted survival. Our data unveils an adaptive mechanism to AA starvation, when mTORC1 evades inhibition.
abstract_zh: 对游离氨基酸（AA）短缺的适应由两条通路介导：整合应激反应（ISR）和雷帕霉素机制靶点（mTOR）。响应于水平降低，主要是亮氨酸或精氨酸的减少，mTOR在其复合物1构型（mTORC1）中被抑制，导致翻译起始和延伸的减少。eIF2alpha激酶一般控制非抑制性2（GCN2）被未负载的tRNA激活，从而在更广泛的AA短缺范围内诱导ISR。ISR赋予翻译起始的减少，同时促进应激蛋白（如ATF4）的选择性合成。为有效适应AA饥饿，这两条通路在多个层面进行交叉调控。在此，我们识别了一种新的ISR/mTORC1串扰机制，该机制在AA饥饿条件下优化生存，当mTORC1被迫保持活跃时。在急性AA短缺期间，mTORC1激活以GCN2依赖性方式增强ATF4表达。在这些条件下，增强的GCN2活性不依赖于tRNA感知，暗示了一种不同的激活机制。我们识别了GCN2与mTOR之间一种不稳定的物理相互作用，该相互作用导致mTOR对GCN2丝氨酸230位点的磷酸化，从而促进GCN2活性。在长期AA饥饿条件下检查时，mTOR对GCN2的磷酸化促进了生存。我们的数据揭示了在mTORC1逃避抑制时对AA饥饿的一种适应机制。
